epics.title: Source-derived Gantry documentation
epics.objective: Give users and developers an implementation-accurate written and visual map of Gantry with honest verification evidence.

tasks.title: Finalize current-state documentation and static explorer
tasks.objective: Deliver the source-derived guide, issue report, active documentation corrections, metadata corrections, and responsive static explorer.
acceptance_criteria: Guide covers every subsystem named in the approved plan using source-derived evidence.
Teams and durable-memory boundaries match executable implementation.
Static explorer is self-contained, searchable, expandable, accessible, responsive, and free of browser console errors.
verify_commands: npx prettier --check README.md docs/README.md docs/CODEBASE_GUIDE.md docs/architecture/README.md docs/architecture/components.md docs/architecture/overview.md docs/architecture/runtime-components.md bug.md index.html packages/sdk/README.md package.json packages/contracts/package.json packages/sdk/package.json
required_tests: Desktop and 390px mobile functional browser check
Search filtering and details expansion interaction check
reviewer_focus: Implementation accuracy and absence of unsupported claims
Static page accessibility, responsive behavior, and dependency-free operation
Clear distinction between current behavior, historical intent, and reproduced defects

tasks.title: Repair repository documentation navigation
tasks.objective: Make every checked relative Markdown/HTML target resolve without changing historical meaning.
acceptance_criteria: Repository-wide Markdown/HTML checker reports zero missing relative targets.
Historical prose is unchanged except for link-target syntax.
Line-specific citations use GitHub-compatible #L fragments where applicable.
required_tests: Diff inspection limited to navigation targets
reviewer_focus: Correct relative depth and GitHub line-anchor syntax
No placeholder or code-example false positives converted into links

tasks.title: Record complete verification and review evidence
tasks.objective: Prove the documentation package against deterministic checks, runtime tests, functional behavior, and the three required review lenses.
acceptance_criteria: Tracked-tree scanner and TypeScript parser coverage is re-established.
Architecture, typecheck, unit, and build commands pass.
Lint and production audit findings match bug.md exactly.
Automated and functional test evidence is schema-valid.
One autoreview run records passing quality, performance, and security artifacts.
required_tests: Full unit suite and complete build
reviewer_focus: Inherited failures are not attributed to the documentation diff
No runtime, performance, or security behavior changed
